subject: MedFlow demo follow-up: compliance Q&A, SOC 2 Type II request & portal provisioning
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@medflow.com>, security@medflow.com
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-04T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: MedFlow demo follow-up: compliance Q&A, SOC 2 Type II request & portal provisioning

Hi Lena — thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

- Ask: Can MedFlow share the latest SOC 2 Type II report (or tell us the expected delivery window)? If you have a bridge letter/temporary attestation while the report is in review, that would help us a lot.
- Portal access: We typically use the Redwood Trust Portal for evidence exchange. Would you be able to provision an account for "medflow@redwood.com" (we can supply a list of users) or invite us to your secure vendor folder? If there are constraints, SFTP as a fallback works.
- Vendor questionnaire: Attached is a short VSQ we use to speed intake — if you can start with that, we’ll align on any follow-ups. (attachment: medflow_vsq_v1.xlsx)

Proposed timeline: if you can share the bridge letter or portal access by EOD Oct 6 we can unblock the security review and keep the deal on the October SLA.

Notes from the call: MedFlow will process PHI for certain use cases and has EU customers; please flag any data residency or third-party processor nuances.

Next steps: 
1) Lena — confirm whether you can share SOC 2 Type II, or a bridge letter (and who will be our portal admin contact).
2) We’ll introduce Security for the evidence handoff and bridge-letter redaction guidance.

Thanks —
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments attached: medflow_vsq_v1.xlsx
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@medflow.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: security@medflow.com
Date: 2026-10-04T18:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MedFlow demo follow-up: compliance Q&A, SOC 2 Type II request & portal provisioning

Thanks Jasmine — great demo and clear recap. Quick answers: 

- SOC 2 Type II: We completed our audit in August; our external auditor requires a short redaction review before distribution. We can provide a bridge letter this week while we finalize the redactions.
- Portal: We can provision an account in our secure evidence portal. Please provide the user list (emails) and the minimally required access level. Our security team is copied on this email (security@medflow.com).
- VSQ: I downloaded medflow_vsq_v1.xlsx and started populating a few fields — I’ll return a partially completed version by tomorrow.

Couple of asks: 
1) What level of redaction guidance do you need for the SOC 2 (PII/PHI suppression)?
2) For bridge letters, any standard templating you prefer? If you can share Redwood’s sample, that will speed things up.

We plan to have the bridge letter ready to share by Oct 6 if that aligns with your timeline.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Head of Procurement, MedFlow
lena.ortiz@medflow.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: MedFlow demo follow-up: compliance Q&A, SOC 2 Type II request & portal provisioning

Aditya / Ben — forwarding Lena’s reply from MedFlow. TL;DR: SOC 2 Type II exists, they’ll share a bridge letter by Oct 6, and they can provision portal access.

Requests: 
- Can Security draft a short bridge letter template we can attach (redwood_bridgeletter_template.pdf) and send redaction guidance for the auditor-provided Type II? Lena asked what we prefer re: PII/PHI suppression.
- Please confirm who on our side to add as portal users (Jasmine, Jordan, security@redwood.com?) and whether we should request SFTP as fallback.
- If possible, estimate when we can complete the security review after they share the bridge letter and portal access. This is time-sensitive for the pricing/commit window.

Deal: DEAL-8472 — MedFlow (US) — aiming to close October.

Thanks —
Jordan
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-06T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MedFlow compliance intake / bridge letter & portal provisioning

Jordan — thanks for the ping. Quick plan from Security: 

1) Bridge letter: I attached the redwood_bridgeletter_template.pdf to this thread as a starting point. We will provide guidance to MedFlow on acceptable redactions: suppress direct identifiers and PHI items not required for control testing, but leave control descriptions intact. We can review their redacted draft prior to distribution.
2) Portal provisioning: Please confirm the user list; we recommend provisioning these initial seats: jasmine.liu@redwood.com, jordan.blake@redwood.com, and security@redwood.com. If MedFlow prefers, we’ll accept an SFTP fallback; provide creds via their portal invite or SFTP out-of-band.
3) Timeline: If MedFlow shares the bridge letter and portal invite by EOD Oct 6, we expect Security review to conclude within 48 business hours barring unexpected findings. If redactions are extensive we may need an extra day.

Action items for Jordan/Jasmine: send the user emails for portal access and confirm whether you want any extra seats provisioned. I’ll follow up with Ben to coordinate final review and sign-off.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com
